name: Team Bulbasaur: Sevii Ironbreaker Vanguard
archetype: Sevii archipelago & Jasmine duel core — Fire incineration, 4x Ice execution, 4x Fighting breaking, Intimidate physical dampening, and Levitate Ground immunity.
gym_duel_rationale: Jasmine challenges the player on Bond Bridge in a 5 vs 5 duel. Slots 1 through 5 enter the arena: Venusaur/Charizard (Slot 1) incinerates Skarmory/Dodrio and Scizor/Cacturne with STAB Flamethrower and uses Sleep Powder for crowd control; Lapras (Slot 2) walls water attacks with Water Absorb and deletes Altaria/Steelix with 4x STAB Ice Beam; Kingler/Primeape (Slot 3) shatters Mawile/Rhydon with 4x STAB Close Combat; Gyarados/Arbok (Slot 4) provides Intimidate to defang Jasmine's massive physical powerhouses; and Alakazam/Weezing (Slot 5) floats above Ground moves with Levitate and supports with Calm Mind and Recover. Snorlax rests in reserve as the route endurance tank.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST starter hybrid elevated to Cap 76. STAB Flamethrower incinerates Jasmine's Skarmory/Dodrio and Scizor/Cacturne for clean OHKOs. Sleep Powder neutralizes dangerous setup sweepers immediately.
535 BST Water/Ice fortress elevated to Lv. 75. Water Absorb completely negates opposing water moves across Brine Road East. STAB Ice Beam hits Altaria/Steelix for fatal 4x super-effective damage.
500 BST physical bruiser. STAB Close Combat delivers catastrophic 4x super-effective damage against Mawile/Rhydon and breaks Magnezone/Blastoise.
513 BST Intimidate pivot. Lowers Jasmine's physical Attack on entry to blunt incoming Earthquakes and Head Smashes. Glare secures 100% paralysis on fast threats.
495 BST Levitate pivot with 118 SpA. Immune to Earthquake and Earth Power via Levitate. Sets Calm Mind and fires powerful special attacks while shrugging off ground strikes.
Colossal 160 HP route sponge holding Leftovers. RestTalk loop absorbs wild status and damage across Kin Island and Berry Forest while resting in reserve during the 5v5 Gym duel.

flex_bench.rationale: 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder for securing rare wild catches in Berry Forest and Bond Bridge.
Discharge and Light Screen to sweep water routes and zap opposing flyers.
High Jump Kick physical breaker for Rock and Normal type route encounters.
